title: Bounded-below continuity for open direct image and closed support
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. For every scheme $T$, put $B_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], and use the ordinary uncompleted category $D(B_T)=D(\operatorname{Mod}_{B_T})$ [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. Let $T$ be a scheme with Noetherian underlying topological space (descending chains of closed subsets stabilize), $i:Z\hookrightarrow T$ closed and $j:U\hookrightarrow T$ its open complement [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-open-immersion]. Use $Rj_*$ and $Ri^!$ from [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-open-closed-recollement], with $Ri^!$ the derived right adjoint of $i_*$. All sites and indexing categories are small in the fixed module universe [def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Filtered colimits below are termwise sheaf colimits of functorial complex representatives, and all comparison maps are induced by the original cocone. For every small filtered diagram $(N_i)$ of $B_T$-module complexes with $H^{<c}(N_i)=0$, and every such diagram $(V_i)$ on $U$ with $H^{<c}(V_i)=0$, the natural maps
$$\varinjlim_i Ri^!N_i\longrightarrow Ri^!(\varinjlim_iN_i),\qquad \varinjlim_iRj_*V_i\longrightarrow Rj_*(\varinjlim_iV_i)$$
are isomorphisms. Both functors preserve $D^{\ge c}$ for every integer $c$ [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category]. No local Noetherianity of the structure sheaf, cohomological dimension bound or constructibility of the targets is assumed.

source.place: Tag 09BM (lemma-closed-immersion-complement-retrocompact-exact); agent support-triangle extraction of the bounded-below route in Bhatt–Scholze Lemmas 6.3.14 and 6.8.12, using det-pe-bounded-continuity-direct-image.

proof.text: Every open subspace of the Noetherian underlying space of T is Noetherian. The open embedding j therefore has Noetherian source, and preimages of affine opens are compact; this gives QuasiCompact j. Open immersions are monomorphisms and hence quasi-separated. Rewrite the complement equality to the orientation range(i) = complement(range(j)) used by the closed-support API.

The internal module categories are Grothendieck by [lem-sfb-modobj-grothendieck], as specialized by supportModules_grothendieck. Thus filtered colimits are exact. The proved DegreewiseLimits homology-preservation instance identifies homology of a termwise filtered colimit with the filtered colimit of homology. Naturality of colimit.post then proves that colimMap of a pointwise quasi-isomorphism is a quasi-isomorphism (private helper quasiIso_colimMap).

For a strictly bounded diagram E, the good-truncation projection is an actual isomorphism at each E_s, so the cocone condensedContinuityCocone E c is a colimit cocone. Its vertex comparison from colim E is therefore invertible. The identity colimit.post_desc transfers continuity for that cocone to continuity for colimit.cocone E (private helper comparison_of_strict_cocone). For a merely cohomologically bounded diagram D use alpha:D -> truncGE_c D. Each alpha_s is a quasi-isomorphism by isGE_Q_obj_iff and quasiIso_πTruncGE_iff; step 2 makes colimMap alpha a quasi-isomorphism. After any functor out of the derived localization, both these vertex and diagram comparisons are invertible. The naturality square for colimit.post transfers continuity from the strict diagram back to the original cocone (private helper comparison_of_cohomological_bound).

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-closed-costalk-derived-continuity] on T to H=closedSupport Lambda i j, with the actual adjunction closedSupportAdjunction from [det-lem-formal-closed-support-adjunction]. This is already a theorem about the same internal module categories and the same ordinary rightDerivedFunctor. It gives the cohomology continuity comparisons for every strictly bounded diagram. Step 3 extends them to every input diagram N having the stated cohomological lower bound. This reuses the existing support-triangle and five-lemma argument, without reconstructing it or changing coefficient presentations.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-qcqs-pushforward-continuity] to j and a strictly bounded diagram on U, using step 1. A strict bound implies vanishing of homology below c, as its hypothesis requires. Step 3 gives the cohomology continuity comparisons on the original cocone for every cohomologically bounded V. This theorem directly uses lowerStar Lambda j, so no change of section-ring presentation or scalar restriction comparison is necessary.

For any additive functor F out of a Grothendieck abelian category, construct a natural isomorphism Q followed by RF with the localization of the functorial K-injective replacement followed by F on complexes (private definition resolutionDerivedIso). The natural quasi-isomorphism to the replacement becomes invertible under Q. The derived unit on the replacement is invertible because that replacement is K-injective; compose these with the quotient/Qh factorization isomorphisms. This is a real construction from [lem-sfb-grothendieck-k-injective] and the right-derived unit, and includes naturality at every original cocone leg. In each degree compose with the localization/homology comparison. The colimit universal property transports the comparisons of steps 4 and 5 to the homology of the resolution-model comparisons. Homology preserves filtered colimits by step 2; cancel its colimit comparison using colimit.post_post. Every homology map of the resolution-model comparison is invertible, hence it is a quasi-isomorphism and its Q-image is an isomorphism. These are exactly the first two conjuncts (private helper resolutionComparison_isIso). Retain the import of [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], which records this total derived functor and is part of the unit route.

Closed direct image is exact by closedSupport_lowerStarExact, and its right derived adjoint is the rightDerivedFunctor of closedSupport, by [det-lem-formal-closed-support-adjunction]. Apply exactDerivedAdjunction_isGE from [lem-pur-exact-derived-adjunction-bounds] to this adjunction for the third conjunct. Apply the same theorem to the exact supportPullback Lambda j and closedSupportOpenDerivedAdjunction for the fourth conjunct. Both preserve the prescribed integer c without changing hypotheses.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 5.3(1), and the final support-fibre-sequence paragraph of its proof, reused through condensed_qcqs_pushforward_continuity and condensed_closed_costalk_derived_continuity. Agent-written good-truncation, natural K-injective-resolution, and original-cocone comparison arguments; lower bounds by exact-derived adjunction orthogonality. Stacks 09BM supplies exactness of closed direct image through the existing closed-support API.

lean.statement: theorem closedSupport_bounded_continuity (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}) [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] {T Z U : Scheme.{u}} [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace T] (i : Z ⟶ T) [IsClosedImmersion i] (j : U ⟶ T) [IsOpenImmersion j] (_hij : Set.range j = (Set.range i)ᶜ) (c : ℤ) : (∀ (I : Type (u + 1)) [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I] (N : I ⥤ CochainComplex (supportModules Λ T) ℤ), (∀ t : I, (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (N.obj t)).IsGE c) → IsIso (DerivedCategory.Q.map (colimit.post N (CochainComplex.kInjectiveResolutionFunctor.{u + 1} (supportModules Λ T) ⋙ (closedSupport Λ i j).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ))))) ∧ (∀ (I : Type (u + 1)) [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I] (V : I ⥤ CochainComplex (supportModules Λ U) ℤ), (∀ t : I, (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (V.obj t)).IsGE c) → IsIso (DerivedCategory.Q.map (colimit.post V (CochainComplex.kInjectiveResolutionFunctor.{u + 1} (supportModules Λ U) ⋙ (lowerStar Λ j).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ))))) ∧ (∀ K : DerivedCategory (supportModules Λ T), K.IsGE c → ((closedSupport Λ i j).rightDerivedFunctor.obj K).IsGE c) ∧ (∀ K : DerivedCategory (supportModules Λ U), K.IsGE c → ((lowerStar Λ j).rightDerivedFunctor.obj K).IsGE c)
